title: feat(auth): add JWT token generation helper
description: Provides utility function to generate signed JWT tokens for authenticated users.

ground_truth.description: Hardcoded symmetric JWT secret key stored in plaintext source code.
ground_truth.explanation: Embedding credentials directly into source control enables token forgery and unauthorized authentication (CWE-798, Bandit B105).

expected_evidence.description: Bandit B105 flag for hardcoded password/secret string.
